title: Enter into Italy
intro: The route leaves Slovenia and crosses into Italy for a compact visit to Venice. After parking at Tronchetto, take a scenic vaporetto along the Grand Canal to St. Mark's Square, spend around two hours exploring the waterfront and walking toward Rialto Bridge, then return by vaporetto to Tronchetto before driving west to Brescia. Allow approximately 3–3.5 hours for the entire stop, including boat rides and parking.
